title: 报告呢？
setting: An open-plan office in Shenzhen, Friday, 5:55 pm. The report was due at noon.

caught.narr: Your boss pulls up a chair beside you, folds her arms and watches you type.
caught.zh: 王总搬了把椅子，坐在你旁边看着你。

caught.en: Caught. Your boss watches every keystroke until nine o'clock.
caught.zh: 你在王总的注视下，一直改到了晚上九点。

steps.narr: Friday, 5:55 pm. The report was due at noon. It isn't finished.
steps.zh: 周五下午五点五十五，报告中午就该交了。

say.tip: 马上 mǎshàng, literally 'on horseback', = right away. 马上就好 = any second now: said by waiters, mechanics and everyone with a deadline.

ok.en: Good. I'll come over and have a look.

steps.narr: You grab your laptop and walk very fast. Not running. Walking fast.

steps.en: Where've you gone? How's the revision going?

say.tip: 正在 + verb = in the middle of it. 改 gǎi = revise. 在改了在改了, doubled, is 'yes, yes, I'm on it'.

steps.narr: Seventh floor, the pantry. Xiao Li is making instant noodles.
steps.zh: 七楼茶水间，小李在泡面。

say.en: Tell him: don't say you're here!
say.tip: 别说 = don't say. 千万 = whatever you do: 千万别说! And 就说…… = just tell them...

steps.en: So when exactly are you sending it?

say.gloss: I'll send it to you in five minutes!
say.tip: ……后 = in (a time): 五分钟后 = in five minutes. 发给您 = send it to you, with the polite 您 for a boss.

steps.narr: The roof terrace. Dead end. One bar of signal.
steps.zh: 天台，没路了，信号只有一格。

say.tip: 最后一页 = the last page. 就剩……了 = there's only ... left: 就剩一页了.

not.note: 没收到 says you DIDN'T get it. 收到 alone is 'got it'.

say.tip: 收到 shōudào = received: the office 'roger that'. 这就 + verb = this very second: 这就发, 这就来.

steps.narr: Your boss comes out onto the roof, out of breath, reading her phone.
steps.zh: 王总追上来，喘着气看手机。
收到了。不过我不是为这个来的。
steps.en: Got it. But that's not why I came.

steps.zh: 年会跳舞，就差你一个了！
steps.en: The dance at the annual party: you're the only one we're missing!

say.en: Get out of it: you can't dance!
say.tip: 不会 = can't, never learned how (能 is about being able right now). 我不会跳 is the classic way out of a 年会 dance. It never works.

fail.en: Nothing to say? Then it's settled!

steps.en: Report sent, chase survived. Next month you and your boss are front row at the annual party, dancing badly, in matching tracksuits.
steps.zh: 下个月年会，你和王总站在第一排。
